name: hud_ui_text_input_dispatch_key_action
description: HudUiTextInput::DispatchKeyAction maps keyActionMap entries to HudUiTextInput ftable actions and ignores action values above 7.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4b4460 confirms signed key lookup through keyActionMap at this+0x10, action dispatch for values 0..7 through HudUiTextInput_FTable slots 0, 1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 6, and 7, and no-op return for action values above 7. tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiTextInput class/source-cluster pass.
